description: Precision rectifier giving full wave and both half wave rectifications of its input around a settable axis, each with a sign-flipped copy

params.text: Sets how far the AXIS CV input moves the rectification axis
Sets the voltage the input is rectified around, -10V to +10V

inputs.text: The signal to be rectified; polyphonic, with every channel rectified around the same axis
Moves the rectification axis from a voltage, scaled by the CV amount knob and added to the AXIS knob

outputs.text: Carries the distance of the input from the axis, so both halves of the wave fold to the same side and the signal never goes below zero
Carries the input wherever it is above the axis, and the axis voltage wherever it is below
Carries the input wherever it is below the axis, and the axis voltage wherever it is above
Carries the distance of the input from the axis with the sign flipped, so both halves of the wave fold downwards and the signal never goes above zero
Carries the input where it is above the axis and the axis voltage where it is below, with the sign flipped
Carries the input where it is below the axis and the axis voltage where it is above, with the sign flipped
